main_text.p: din incolumem ad nominis sui gloriam servare dignetur.
main_text.head: Vester bonus Consanguineus
HENRICUS ALLIARIUS.
XXXIII. RESPONSORIA Julii Brunsv. & Luneb. D. ad HENRICUM NAVARRÆ REGEM.
main_text.p: LIteras tuas ad nos per Jacobum Segurium tuum legatum missas accepimus, eidemq; tuo legato, quæ abs te Serenis. Rex. in mandatis habebat, coram intimis nostri consilii viris fecimus exponendi facultatem, cum invaletudine & compluribus aliis incommoditatibus impediti, audien-tiam.

page.notes: Initial L is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "Iteras"; the first word is printed as "LIteras" with the initial. Several specks and stray marks in the margins are not text. Some words in the running text are faint and read with some uncertainty, notably "invaletudine" and "incommoditatibus".
